title: Item 8: a season of v7.0 with the roster builder on CTRL (surface; caverns closed).
fork: v7.0 with the roster builder on: do arrivals by guild follow the ladder, how many kills per arrival, what predator share, and (OCEAN2) do placed pelagic apexes strand.

predictions.expects: arrival shares by guild track the builder's FREQUENCY ladder within a few points; apex and meso arrivals are rare
predator arrivals near the builder's target (~15% on land), kills per arrival under 1

kill_criterion: the tool off or the builder unfilled on every layer (no 's8 build' line with filled slots) voids the run
culling: the first sample (pre-existing units are listed as 'new' at t0)

arms.name: v70
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.layers.land=true; cfg.layers.cavern=true; cfg.layers.water=false; cfg.groups.enabled=true; cfg.groups.cavern=true; cfg.ecology.enabled=true; cfg.water.enabled=false; cfg.v7.builder=true; sw.saveConfig(cfg); for _,l in ipairs('land','cavern') do local ok,out=pcall(dfhack.run_command_silent,'seasonal-wildlife','roster','build',l); print(('s8 build %s: %s'):format(l, (out or '?'):gsub('\n',' | '):sub(1,1500))) end; dfhack.run_command_silent('seasonal-wildlife','enable'); local c2=sw.loadConfig(); print(('s8 cfg enabled=%s builder=%s gate_drain=%s domestic=%s'):format(tostring(c2.enabled),tostring(c2.v7.builder),tostring(c2.v7.gate_drain),tostring(c2.v7.domestic)))

do: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); local by={}; for _,e in ipairs(sw.buildPool(cfg)) do by[e.token]=by[e.token] or e end; _G.__s8seen=_G.__s8seen or {}; local S=_G.__s8seen; local cnt,new,beach={},{},0; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if sw.WILD.onMap(u) then local cr=df.creature_raw.find(u.race); local t=cr and cr.creature_id or '?'; local e=by[t]; local L=sw.WILD.layerOf(u); local k=L..':'..(e and e.guild or '-'); cnt[k]=(cnt[k] or 0)+1; if not S[u.id] then S[u.id]=true; new[#new+1]=k..':'..t end; if e and e.guild=='PE' then local d=dfhack.maps.getTileFlags(u.pos); if not (d and d.flow_size>=4) then beach=beach+1 end end end end; local o={} for k,v in pairs(cnt) do o[#o+1]=k..'='..v end; table.sort(o); local odds={} for k,v in pairs(cfg.odds or {}) do odds[#odds+1]=k..'='..v end; table.sort(odds); print(('s8 tick=%d units %s | new %s | pelagic_beached=%d | odds_n=%d'):format(df.global.cur_year_tick, table.concat(o,' '), table.concat(new,' '), beach, #odds))
